name: theme.mixed_hostile_camp_siege_mcw
description: Full-scene thematic stress playtest: a McWilliams camp-adjacent scene carries active bandit pressure, cannibal pressure, a writhing stalker, a zombie horde, a zombie rider, a flesh-raptor, and a night fire/smoke cue so the tester can judge whether CAOL hostile systems compose into tension or incoherent noise.

steps.label: post_load_mixed_siege_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: post-load gameplay screen for the mixed hostile camp-siege footing; startup/load and scene-footing evidence only

steps.label: preflight_mixed_siege_midnight
steps.abort_reason: saved game turn did not prove the intended midnight siege footing

steps.label: preflight_mixed_siege_bandit_active_job
steps.abort_reason: saved bandit_live_world state did not contain the active bandit pressure job

steps.label: preflight_mixed_siege_cannibal_active_job
steps.abort_reason: saved bandit_live_world state did not contain the active cannibal pressure job

steps.label: preflight_mixed_siege_monsters
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not contain the staged stalker, rider, and raptor

steps.label: preflight_mixed_siege_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved horde metadata did not contain the staged nearby zombie horde

steps.label: confirm_safe_mode_off_before_mixed_siege
steps.expected_visible_fact: fixture loads with safe mode off, so gameplay remains focused before the mixed-threat window

steps.label: advance_120_turns_mixed_siege_local_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: a bounded local night combat/pressure window advanced with bandit, cannibal, stalker, rider, raptor, horde, and fire/smoke ingredients staged

steps.label: audit_mixed_siege_live_systems
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug artifact did not prove all staged mixed-siege hostile systems participated during the bounded live window
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run debug artifact proves the bounded mixed-siege window exercised bandit/cannibal jobs, horde signal, stalker, rider, and raptor behavior

playtest_rubric.primary_question: Did the systems create layered tension, or did stacked primitives make unreadable, unfair, or inert behavior?

evidence_contract.claim: a deliberately dense CAOL hostile scene can be staged and advanced for subjective full-system review
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for mixed-siege behavior
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No mixed-siege credit unless startup/load, all preflight hostile ingredients, local-window capture, and same-run live-system artifact proof are separated in the report.
